title: Simulation 3D Helicopter Pack
text: Generate translation and rotation information for helicopter, 38 inputs, 2 outputs, {Select input coordinate frame} sets Input coordinate frame; {Engine 1 translation} sets the option to enable Engine1_T input port, {Engine 2 translation} sets the option to enable Engine2_T input port, {Rotor 1 translation} sets the option to enable Rotor1_T input port, {Rotor 2 translation} sets the option to enable Rotor2_T input port, {Engine 1 rotation} sets the option to enable Engine1_R input port, {Engine 2 rotation} sets the option to enable Engine2_R input port, {Rotor 1 rotation} sets the option to enable Rotor1_R input port, {Rotor 2 rotation} sets the option to enable Rotor2_R input port, {Nose gear translation} sets the option to enable Nose_Gear_T input port, {Nose wheel translation} sets the option to enable Nose_Wheel_T input port, {Nose gear door 1 translation} sets the option to enable Nose_Gear_Door1_T input, {Nose gear door 2 translation} sets the option to enable Nose_Gear_Door2_T input, {Left gear translation} sets the option to enable Left_Gear_T input port, {Left wheel translation} sets the option to enable Left_Wheel_T input port, {Left gear door 1 translation} sets the option to enable Left_Gear_Door1_T input, {Left gear door 2 translation} sets the option to enable Left_Gear_Door2_T input, {Right gear translation} sets the option to enable Right_Gear_T input port, {Right wheel translation} sets the option to enable Right_Wheel_T input port, {Right gear door 1 translation} sets the option to enable Right_Gear_Door1_T input, {Right gear door 2 translation} sets the option to enable Right_Gear_Door2_T input, {Nose gear rotation} sets the option to enable Nose_Gear_R input port, {Nose wheel rotation} sets the option to enable Nose_Wheel_R input port, {Nose gear door 1 rotation} sets the option to enable Nose_Gear_Door1_R input, {Nose gear door 2 rotation} sets the option to enable Nose_Gear_Door2_R input, {Left gear rotation} sets the option to enable Left_Gear_R input port, {Left wheel rotation} sets the option to enable Left_Wheel_R input port, {Left gear door 1 rotation} sets the option to enable Left_Gear_Door1_R input, {Left gear door 2 rotation} sets the option to enable Left_Gear_Door2_R input, {Right gear rotation} sets the option to enable Right_Gear_R input port, {Right wheel rotation} sets the option to enable Right_Wheel_R input port, {Right gear door 1 rotation} sets the option to enable Right_Gear_Door1_R input, {Right gear door 2 rotation} sets the option to enable Right_Gear_Door2_R input, {Sensor 1 translation} sets the option to enable Sensor1_T input port, {Sensor 2 translation} sets the option to enable Sensor2_T input port, {Sensor 1 rotation} sets the option to enable Sensor1_R input port and {Sensor 2 rotation} sets the option to enable Sensor2_R input port. Values come from the instance.
